Method of Attack: used vulnerable Pulse Secure VPN servers as a point of entry
exploitation of CVE-2019-11510 vulnerability to compromise VPN servers and execute arbitrary commands
Attack Vector: exploitation of unpatched Pulse Secure VPN servers vulnerable to CVE-2019-11510
exploitation of vulnerable Citrix ADC (NetScaler) servers with CVE-2019-1978 and CVE-2019-19781 vulnerabilities
Indicators of Compromise: ransomware attack detected on Finastra servers
